description: This file implements tracing and event logging functionalities, including classes and methods for writing trace events to files, handling event ring buffers, formatting timestamps, and serializing trace events for logging and analysis.

classes.name: event_trace_writer
classes.description: Handles writing trace events to files, managing file splitting, ring buffer for event processing, and concurrency control.

classes.name: trace_event_extended
classes.description: Extended trace event with CPU, thread name, and duration information.

classes.name: instant_trace_event_extended
classes.description: Extended instant trace event with CPU, thread name, and timestamp.

classes.name: rusage_trace_event_extended
classes.description: Extended resource usage trace event including resource usage differences.

methods.name: ocudu::open_trace_file
methods.description: Initializes the trace file writer with specified filename and parameters.

methods.name: ocudu::close_trace_file
methods.description: Closes the current trace file writer.

methods.name: ocudu::is_trace_file_open
methods.description: Checks if a trace file is currently open.
